title: App Store header (iOS 27)
brief: The iOS 27 App Store product-page header (21:9, 3840 × 1646) and search-results card (3:2): a 15 s muted loop that says what Curate does before anyone reads a word. Three directions on one Mist stage, picked by the founder at G2: roll (her photos give up what she's wearing and it becomes her real wardrobe), tryon (the black tee flies onto her walk-to-work photo and Studio's real try-on wipes over her), zee (Zee waves, his real chat plans her Monday, the look rises beside him). Real new-look screens (build 264), Emma's real photos and wardrobe cut-outs, Apple's iPhone bezel. Redo of studies/ob172 (rejected: 'cheap quality').
hook: 0–2 s: one real thing, big and lit, on a calm stage (her photos / her photo and the tee / Zee in a pool of light); the first words at 0.9 s.
disclosures: iPhone is a trademark of Apple Inc., registered in the U.S. and other countries.
Emma is an AI-generated persona and her photos are AI-generated.
